name: Fakturownia
description: Fakturownia.pl invoicing API for Polish businesses: invoices with PDF and KSeF status, proforma invoices, clients, products, recorded payments, warehouses and warehouse documents. Issuing, sending, cancelling and deleting invoices are switched off. API token and account prefix.
instructions:
## Fakturownia
This connector works with the **Fakturownia.pl API** (`https://YOUR_PREFIX.fakturownia.pl`), the Polish online invoicing service: invoices and other documents (read, PDF, KSeF status), proforma invoices, clients, products, recorded payments, warehouses and warehouse documents, departments and categories.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to Fakturownia and open **Ustawienia, Ustawienia konta, Integracja** (Settings, Account settings, Integration).
2. Under **Kod autoryzacyjny API** (API authorization code) copy the token, or generate one first. Paste it into `FAKTUROWNIA_API_TOKEN`.
3. Enter the prefix of your account address into `FAKTUROWNIA_DOMAIN`: for `https://mojafirma.fakturownia.pl` it is `mojafirma`.

API access is part of the paid plans (and of the trial). The token acts as the user who created it and is sent as the `api_token` query parameter on every call.

**Where to start**: `fakturownia_list_invoices` (this month by default), then `fakturownia_get_invoice` for the lines and `fakturownia_get_invoice_pdf` for the document. `fakturownia_list_clients` and `fakturownia_list_products` find ids for new documents.

**Invoices (read)**: `fakturownia_list_invoices`, `fakturownia_get_invoice`, `fakturownia_get_invoice_pdf`, `fakturownia_get_invoice_ksef_status`, `fakturownia_list_recurring_invoices`. Filter with period (this_month, last_month, last_12_months, all, or more with date_from and date_to); search_date_type picks issue, payment or sale date. Cost invoices: income no.

**Proformas**: `fakturownia_create_proforma` creates a proforma (not a tax document, never sent to KSeF, nothing e-mailed). Turning it into a VAT invoice is done in Fakturownia or with `fakturownia_create_invoice`.

**Switched off at install** (they issue, change or remove legal documents, or contact customers): `fakturownia_create_invoice`, `fakturownia_update_invoice`, `fakturownia_change_invoice_status`, `fakturownia_send_invoice_by_email`, `fakturownia_cancel_invoice`, `fakturownia_delete_invoice`, `fakturownia_create_payment` and `fakturownia_delete_client`. A VAT invoice is a tax document; in an account connected to KSeF it may be submitted to the national e-invoicing system, which cannot be undone (mistakes need a correction invoice). Turn these tools on only deliberately. No tool moves money.

**Clients and products**: `fakturownia_list_clients` (search by name, e-mail, short name, NIP or external_id), `fakturownia_get_client`, `fakturownia_create_client`, `fakturownia_update_client`; `fakturownia_list_products`, `fakturownia_get_product`, `fakturownia_create_product`, `fakturownia_update_product`. Products take a gross price and a tax rate; the net price is computed.

**Payments, stock, settings**: `fakturownia_list_payments` (recorded payments, read-only), `fakturownia_list_warehouses`, `fakturownia_list_warehouse_documents`, `fakturownia_get_warehouse_document`, `fakturownia_list_departments` (issuers: department_id), `fakturownia_list_categories`.

**Field notes**: ids are numbers. Amounts are decimals in the document currency (default PLN). Tax rates are numbers (23, 8, 5, 0) or the texts zw (exempt) and np (not subject). Statuses: issued, sent, paid, partial, rejected. KSeF state (`gov_status`): ok means accepted with a KSeF number in `gov_id`; processing, send_error and others are explained in `gov_error_messages`. Each invoice has a `token`: the link `/invoice/TOKEN` opens it without login, so do not share it carelessly.

**Paging and limits**: lists take page from 1 and per_page up to 100; a shorter page is the last. Fakturownia does not publish its rate limits; a 429 means wait and retry later. Some refusals come back with HTTP 200 and `"status": "error"`, which the connector reports as a failed call.

FAKTUROWNIA_DOMAIN.label: Account prefix
FAKTUROWNIA_DOMAIN.help: The first part of your Fakturownia address: for https://mojafirma.fakturownia.pl enter mojafirma.
FAKTUROWNIA_DOMAIN.patternMessage: Enter only the prefix, for example mojafirma, without https:// or .fakturownia.pl.

FAKTUROWNIA_API_TOKEN.label: API token
FAKTUROWNIA_API_TOKEN.help: Ustawienia, Ustawienia konta, Integracja: Kod autoryzacyjny API. Generate it there if it is empty.

401.hint: Fakturownia refused the API token. Copy it again from Ustawienia, Ustawienia konta, Integracja (Kod autoryzacyjny API), and check that the account prefix matches the account of that token.

verifyHints.403: The token is valid but its user may not do this (user permissions or plan). Check the user rights in Fakturownia.

404.hint: Nothing found. If every call answers 404, the account prefix is wrong: for https://mojafirma.fakturownia.pl enter mojafirma.

unreachable.hint: No Fakturownia account answers at this prefix. Enter only the first part of your address.

verifyHints.rate_limited: Fakturownia limited the requests. Wait a moment and try again.

prerequisites: A Fakturownia.pl account on a plan with API access (all paid plans and the trial) and its API authorization code. About 2 minutes.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices and other sales or cost documents, newest first by default: id, number, kind, status (issued, sent, paid, partial, rejected), issue_date, sell_date, payment_to, paid_date, price_net, price_tax, price_gross, paid, currency, buyer_name, buyer_tax_no, client_id, gov_status (KSeF) and the public token. Lines only with include_positions. Up to 100 per page.

period.description: Time window on search_date_type: this_month, last_month, last_30_days, last_12_months, this_year, last_year, all, or more together with date_from and date_to.

date_from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, used with period more.

date_to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, used with period more.

search_date_type.description: Which date period filters on: issue_date (default), paid_date or transaction_date (sale date).

kind.description: Only this document kind, for example vat, proforma, correction or receipt.

client_id.description: Only documents of this client id (numeric).

number.description: Only the document with this exact number, for example `FV 12/11/2026`.

invoice_ids.description: Comma-separated invoice ids to fetch, for example `123,456`.

income.description: no: cost invoices (expenses) instead of sales documents.

include_positions.description: true adds the invoice lines (positions) to every document.

order.description: Sort field: number, updated_at, issue_date, payment_to, paid_date, price_gross, buyer_name and others; add .desc for descending, for example `updated_at.desc`.

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its lines: number, kind, status, dates, seller and buyer data, positions (name, quantity, prices, tax), totals, paid amount, payment_type, currency, description, client_id, department_id and token (public preview link /invoice/TOKEN). Read-only.

tools.name: fakturownia_get_invoice_ksef_status
tools.description: Read the KSeF (Polish national e-invoicing system) state of one invoice: gov_status (ok, processing, send_error, server_error, offline, not_connected and others), gov_id (KSeF number), gov_send_date, gov_error_messages and the verification link. Read-only, does not submit anything.

tools.name: fakturownia_get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of one invoice, attached as a file (up to 4 MB).

tools.name: fakturownia_list_recurring_invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice definitions: id, name, invoice_id (the template), start_date, every (for example 1m), next_invoice_date, end_date, send_email and buyer_email. Read-only.

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_create_proforma
tools.description: Create a proforma invoice (an offer or payment request, not a tax document and never sent to KSeF). Give client_id or buyer data, and the lines. Returns the new document with id, number and token. Nothing is e-mailed.

buyer_name.description: Buyer name, when no client_id is given.

buyer_tax_no.description: Buyer NIP or other tax number.

buyer_email.description: Buyer e-mail (stored only, nothing is sent).

buyer_country.description: Buyer country, ISO 3166 code such as PL.

payment_to_kind.description: Payment term in days (for example "14"), "off" for none, or "other_date" with payment_to.

payment_to.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD, with payment_to_kind other_date.

currency.description: Currency code (default the account currency, usually PLN).

lang.description: Document language, for example pl or en.

department_id.description: Issuing company or department (Settings, Company data) id (numeric).

positions.description: Invoice lines. Each line: name (or product_id), quantity, total_price_gross (or price_net), tax (23, 8, 5, 0, "zw" or "np"), optionally quantity_unit, discount and gtu_code.

tools.name: fakturownia_create_invoice
tools.description: Issue a new document of any kind (VAT invoice, receipt, correction, advance, final and others). A VAT invoice is a tax document; with KSeF active in the account it may be submitted to KSeF, which cannot be undone. Returns the document with id and number. Installed switched off.

invoice.description: Invoice fields as in the Fakturownia API: kind, number (leave out for automatic), issue_date, sell_date, payment_to_kind or payment_to, client_id or buyer_name and buyer_tax_no, department_id, currency, positions (list of name or product_id, quantity, total_price_gross, tax). For example `{"kind":"vat","client_id":1,"payment_to_kind":14,"positions":[{"product_id":5,"quantity":2}]}`.

tools.name: fakturownia_update_invoice
tools.description: Change an existing invoice (partial: only the fields sent). Lines are changed by their id; a line with `_destroy` 1 is removed. Editing an issued tax document has legal effect and a document already in KSeF needs a correction instead. Installed switched off.

tools.name: fakturownia_change_invoice_status
tools.description: Set the status of an invoice: issued, sent, paid, partial or rejected. Marking it paid changes the books and the paid amount (no money moves). Installed switched off.

tools.name: fakturownia_send_invoice_by_email
tools.description: E-mail an invoice to the buyer (or the given addresses) from Fakturownia. With KSeF active, a VAT invoice to a company can only be sent once it has a KSeF number. Installed switched off.

email_to.description: Recipient addresses, comma-separated, up to 5. Leave out to use the buyer e-mail.

email_pdf.description: true attaches the PDF instead of only a link.

tools.name: fakturownia_cancel_invoice
tools.description: Cancel an invoice with an optional reason. A cancelled tax document stays in the register; one already in KSeF needs a correction invoice instead. Installed switched off.

cancel_reason.description: Reason shown on the cancelled document.

tools.name: fakturownia_delete_invoice
tools.description: Delete an invoice permanently. Cannot be undone and breaks the numbering; never use it for documents already in KSeF. Installed switched off.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_clients
tools.description: List or search clients (buyers): id, name, shortcut, tax_no, email, phone, street, post_code, city, country, bank_account, external_id, note and default payment terms. Up to 100 per page.

tax_no.description: Search by NIP or other tax number.

external_id.description: Find the client with this external id (from another system).

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id: name, tax_no, address, e-mail, phone, bank account, external_id, discount, payment_to_kind, default currency, note and tags.

tools.name: fakturownia_create_client
tools.description: Add a client (buyer) with name, tax number, address and contact data. Returns the client with its id.

country.description: Country, ISO 3166 code such as PL.

external_id.description: Id of this client in another system.

payment_to_kind.description: Default payment term in days, for example "14".

tools.name: fakturownia_update_client
tools.description: Change a client (only the fields sent). Existing invoices keep the buyer data they were issued with.

tools.name: fakturownia_delete_client
tools.description: Delete a client from the client list. Cannot be undone. Installed switched off.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_products
tools.description: List products and services: id, name, code, ean_code, price_net, price_gross, tax, currency, quantity_unit, stock level (warehouse_quantity, with warehouse_id), service flag, description and updated_at. Up to 100 per page.

date_from.description: Only products added or changed since this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

warehouse_id.description: Show the stock of this warehouse id (numeric).

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id: name, code, EAN, prices, tax, unit, stock (per warehouse with warehouse_id), category and description.

warehouse_id.description: Show the stock of this warehouse id (numeric).

tools.name: fakturownia_create_product
tools.description: Add a product or service. Give the gross price and the tax rate; Fakturownia computes the net price. Returns the product with its id.

name.description: Product name as printed on invoices.

quantity_unit.description: Unit, for example szt. or godz.

tools.name: fakturownia_update_product
tools.description: Change a product (only the fields sent). Price changes apply to new invoices only.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_payments
tools.description: List payments recorded in Fakturownia (bank and cash receipts linked to invoices): id, name, price, currency, paid, paid_date, kind, invoice_id and description; with include invoices, the linked invoices. Read-only.

include.description: invoices: add the linked invoices to every payment.

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_create_payment
tools.description: Record a payment against one or more invoices (bookkeeping only, no money moves). It changes the paid amount and status of the invoices. Installed switched off.

paid.description: true when the money has arrived.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses: id, name, kind, description. Use the id with the product tools to read stock per warehouse.

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_warehouse_documents
tools.description: List warehouse documents (PZ goods received, WZ goods issued, MM transfers): id, kind, number, issue_date, warehouse_id, client_id, invoice_ids and totals. Up to 100 per page.

date_from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, with period more.

date_to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, with period more.

page.description: Page number from 1. A page shorter than per_page is the last one.

tools.name: fakturownia_get_warehouse_document
tools.description: Get one warehouse document with its lines (product_id, quantity, prices), warehouse and linked invoices.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_departments
tools.description: List the companies and departments of the account (the issuers of documents): id, name, shortcut, tax_no, address and bank account. The id is the department_id of an invoice.

tools.name: fakturownia_list_categories
tools.description: List document categories: id, name and description. The id is the category_id of an invoice.
